answer: Fresh-task bond: each epoch every identity draws a fresh task from a public board: survey a juniper and a cedar plot, then file a key-signed kernel report. Plots never repeat, so work cannot be precomputed. Auditors re-measure a sample; a copied report burns the bond. Fees rise per claim: first 40, k-th 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fakes cost 3,037,000 vs a 40,000 pool. Rented kernel reports lack the claimant's signature. An honest agent pays 40 once.
